judge.model_id: goose provider model (not the pinned jev-1.13.0 judge)

grounded_communication.no_invented_polic.rationale: The agent stated no airline rules to the customer. Its messages only describe the reservation and the change, as shown in the call-0 and call-1 results.

grounded_communication.prices_from_syste.rationale: The agent quoted no fares or fees in any turn, so it stated no price that lacks a tool-result source.

grounded_communication.refunds_match_pay.rationale: The agent stated no refund amounts. The payment_history (gift_card_2550356, 280) is the same in the call-0 and call-1 results, so nothing contradicts the payment records.

policy_compliance.confirmed_before_actin.rationale: Before calling update_reservation_passengers (call-1), the agent listed both passengers and the name change and asked the customer to reply "yes". The customer answered "Yes." before the call was made.

policy_compliance.no_unrequested_actions.rationale: The only write was update_reservation_passengers. It renamed Mei Lee to Mei Garcia and kept Anya Garcia, both dates of birth, the flights, baggage and insurance unchanged (call-1 arguments and result).

policy_compliance.within_fare_rules.rationale: The reservation is basic_economy (call-0 result). The only change was a passenger name, and the policy allows passenger changes while forbidding only flight changes on basic economy. Flights, cabin and passenger count stayed the same (call-1 result).

task_resolution.done_in_full.rationale: The single request was the name change, which the call-1 result confirms. The customer then said "No, that's all," so nothing was left open.

task_resolution.right_change.rationale: The customer asked to change Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. The call-1 result shows passenger 2 as Mei Garcia with the same date of birth (1989-12-13), and everything else is unchanged.

task_resolution.right_reservation.rationale: The customer named 3RK2T9. call-0 shows it belongs to anya_garcia_5901, the user ID the customer gave, and lists Mei Lee as a passenger. call-1 updated that same reservation.
